body:
# ✝ DeathPin

**Never lose your death location again.**  
DeathPin sends a clickable death message after respawn and lets players activate a particle trail leading back to their last death point.

## Features

- Clickable death message after respawn
- Shows death coordinates and direction
- Particle trail guiding players back to their death location
- Auto-stop when the destination is reached
- Death locations are saved in `deaths.yml`
- Configurable particles, sounds and messages
- MiniMessage-supported message format

## Commands

- `/deathpin` - toggle trail
- `/deathpin show` - enable the trail
- `/deathpin hide` - disable the trail
- `/deathpin info` - show last death location
- `/deathpin reload` - reload config

**Aliases:** `/dp`, `/pin`, `/dpin`

## Permissions

- `deathpin.use` - use basic commands
- `deathpin.reload` - reload the config
- `deathpin.bypass.world` - allow cross-world usage

## Compatibility

- Java 17+
- API version: 1.20+
- "Supports Folia"

[Discord](https://discord.gg/ZXebttwaJj)
## Why DeathPin?

DeathPin is designed for players who want a clean and lightweight way to return to their items after dying.  
No bloated systems, no complicated setup — just respawn, click, and follow the trail.
